noMatch.title: Nothing found
noMatch.text: There is no catalog entry for “{query}”.

noSources.title: No sources yet
noSources.text: The catalog lists only what you add as a source yourself: a GitHub repository or an MCP package. Add a source first.

noItems.title: No entries yet
noItems.text: Your sources are added but not read yet. Refresh them so their entries appear here.

sources.title: Catalog sources
sources.intro: A source is a GitHub repository or a package you chose. The catalog looks nowhere else. Disabling a source keeps entries you already installed and their way back.

empty.title: No sources yet
empty.text: Add a GitHub repository with skills or an MCP package so the catalog can show entries.

sources.justRefreshed: just refreshed: {count, plural, one {1 entry found} other {# entries found}}
sources.disableText: “{name}” will then deliver no new entries or versions. What you already installed stays pinned to its version and can still be rolled back.

add.title: Add source

hints.github-skills: A GitHub repository with folders that contain a SKILL.md.
hints.npm-mcp: The name of an MCP server on npm, for example @company/mcp-files.
hints.pypi-mcp: The name of an MCP server on PyPI.
hints.github-mcp: A GitHub repository with a package.json whose package is published on npm.

add.roleHint: Optional. The text appears in the search, for example “Development” or “Research”.

addedNoEntries.title: The source is added but not read yet
addedNoEntries.text: The entries could not be loaded just now. You can refresh the source in the list later.

loadFailed.title: The entry cannot be loaded
loadFailed.text: It no longer exists or you lack permission. Close this view and try again.

notInspected.title: Not inspected yet
notInspected.text: This entry has no inspected version yet. The inspection reads the current state of the source, freezes it and looks for anything unusual.

mcp.title: Start command and environment
mcp.command: Start command (offline, in the isolated agent environment)

permission.isolated agent sandbox: Runs only in the isolated agent environment.
permission.configured egress: Network access only to approved addresses.
permission.network access through agent egress: Calls the network (through the agent's approvals).
permission.project filesystem access: Reads or writes files in the project folder.

files.title: Files of the inspected version
files.notInspected: Files can be viewed only after the inspection.
files.summary: {count, plural, one {1 file} other {# files}}, {scripts, plural, =0 {no scripts} one {1 script} other {# scripts}}
files.hiddenText: The content is not shown because it looks like a password or key.
files.unreadable: The content cannot be read as text.

blocked.title: Blocked – cannot be adopted
blocked.text: The inspection found something that rules out adoption. The reasons are listed below.

review.title: To review – only with your confirmation
review.text: The inspection found anything unusual. Read it through. Adoption works only once you explicitly confirm.

clean.title: Nothing unusual
clean.text: License, version, checksum and content look fine.

findings.title: Inspection findings
findings.license: The license “{license}” is not confirmed as compatible with AGPL-3.0.
findings.pin: There is no exact version number. Without a fixed version nothing can be adopted pinned.
findings.hash: The package has no checksum that could prove its content.
findings.unscanned-dependencies: The package brings {count, plural, one {1 dependency} other {# dependencies}} that {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} neither fixed nor inspected.
findings.executable: Contains executable code or a script that runs on install.
findings.executableSkill: Contains an executable script. Adoption does not import it, only the text.
findings.network-shell: An executable file calls the network or the shell.
findings.secret: The file probably contains a password or key. Its content is not shown.
findings.prompt-injection: The text contains wording meant to make an agent ignore its instructions.
findings.skill-format: The SKILL.md file is missing or has no name or description.

versions.title: Inspected versions

newer.title: New version {pin} is inspected
newer.text: See below what changed. The installed version stays until you update.

versions.count: {count, plural, one {1 inspected version} other {# inspected versions}}
versions.onlyOne: There is only one inspected version so far. Once a new one is inspected you will see here what changed.
versions.pickTwo: Pick two different versions to compare them.
versions.goneFindings: {count, plural, one {1 earlier finding is resolved} other {# earlier findings are resolved}}
versions.fileHidden: The content is not shown because it looks like a password or key.
versions.noChanges: There are no differences between these versions.

notInspected.title: Inspect first, then adopt
notInspected.text: Only an inspected, frozen version is adopted. Inspect the entry first.

adopt.mcpHint: MCP servers run only in the isolated agent environment. If it is off, {appName} refuses the installation.
adopt.acknowledge: I have read the findings and adopt the version anyway.

rollback.title: Way back
rollback.text: The previous version {pin} is kept. You can return to it at any time.
rollback.confirmText: “{name}” will be rolled back to the previous version {pin}. The assignment stays.

hints.library: The entry goes only into the team's library. No agent uses it until you assign it.
hints.project: All agents of this project get the entry.
hints.agent: Only this one agent gets the entry.
hints.role: All agents with this role get the entry, optionally only in one project.

phrase.library: Only in the library, not assigned to any agent

empty.title: No suggestions
empty.text: Agents can suggest skills from the catalog. You decide whether a suggestion is adopted; an agent never installs anything itself.

updates.title: Installed entries
updates.intro: These are the installed entries with their pinned version. “Check for updates” reads the newest state of every source and inspects it. Nothing changes until you adopt a new version.

empty.title: Nothing installed yet
empty.text: As soon as you adopt an entry from the catalog it appears here with its version.

updates.news: {count, plural, one {1 entry has a new version} other {# entries have new versions}}
updates.newsText: Open the entry, look at the difference and the new inspection, then update.

blocked.title: Adoption not possible
blocked.text: The inspection of this version has a blocking finding. It cannot be adopted.

acknowledge.title: Confirmation missing
acknowledge.text: The version has findings you have to confirm first.

sourceDisabled.title: The source is disabled
sourceDisabled.text: Enable the source under “Sources” to read it or adopt anything new.

isolation.title: The isolated agent environment is off
isolation.text: MCP servers may run only in the isolated agent environment. Switch it on first, then the server can be installed.

noPrevious.title: No earlier version
noPrevious.text: There is no previous version to roll back to.

decided.title: Already decided
decided.text: This suggestion has already been decided. Reload the list.

gone.title: No longer in the source
gone.text: The entry is no longer present in the source.

noPin.title: No fixed version
noPin.text: The source names no immutable version. Without one nothing is adopted.

changed.title: Content has changed
changed.text: Different content now sits under the same version. That should never happen. Do not adopt it and check the source.

tooLarge.title: Too large
tooLarge.text: The package or its metadata is larger than allowed.

registry.title: Unexpected address
registry.text: The archive is no longer in the chosen source. It was not loaded.

integrity.title: Checksum does not match
integrity.text: The content does not match what the source states. It was not adopted.

unreachable.title: Source not reachable
unreachable.text: {appName} could not read the source. Check the connection and try again later.

invalidSource.title: Invalid source
invalidSource.text: A source is exactly one GitHub repository or one package name. Check the spelling.

forbidden.title: No permission
forbidden.text: Only the owner of the team may manage the catalog.

conflict.title: Action not possible
conflict.text: The current state does not allow this action. Reload the view and try again.

generic.title: That did not work
generic.text: Try again. If it keeps failing, the reason is in the log.
